messages:
sara.l: hi all — i'm starting on Mon (super excited!) but had a couple of benefits/payroll setup Qs before the first day. 1) i started mid-year, how will PTO/holiday accrual be handled? 2) my benefits effective date says "first day of the month after enrollment" — does that mean i'm uninsured for ~3 weeks? 3) i have receipts for a temporary hotel stay prior to start (relocation). can i submit those now for reimbursement?

marta.hr: welcome, sara! :wave: quick answers: 1) PTO/holiday accrual is prorated from your start date. you'll see a prorated balance in Rippling on day 1 and accruals will align with the standard schedule after that. 2) benefits effective date: for enrollments completed in your first 30 days, most plans become active on the 1st of the next month. that can mean a short gap — if you need immediate coverage (e.g., medical appointment), we can discuss a short-term advance or payback option. 3) yes file relocation receipts now.

josh.payroll: additional payroll notes: if you start mid-pay-period, first paycheck may be partial depending on cutoff. payroll calendar is on the intranet (link below). put your bank info in Rippling ASAP so direct deposit processes on time.

ben.vendor: from benefits vendor side: for medical coverage, if your enrollment is submitted before your start date and approved, we sometimes can fast-track effective date to the first day after your start — depends on carrier. submit passport & enrollment form; i will flag this case. dependent additions: we can accept a marriage cert + passport copy while SSN is pending.

sara.l: thanks — about the gap: i do have a scheduled dentist appt in week 2. can i enroll retroactively if something happens? worried about claim denials.

marta.hr: we don't recommend relying on retroactive enrollment for unexpected claims. options: 1) ask dentist to reschedule after coverage begins, or 2) we can discuss an interim cash advance that you repay if claim denied. ping me privately with the appointment date and we'll take it from there.

sara.l: gotcha. relocation receipts: i paid for two nights at an Airbnb and a taxi. can i scan/attach photos? any naming conventions?

josh.payroll: yes — upload to Expensify and tag "Relocation-NewHire". attach itemized receipts (hotel, transport). if receipt is a photo, include a short note with dates and purpose. if you'd like an advance, DM me with the expected amount and i'll review.

people-ops-bot: checklist created for sara.l — tasks: submit Rippling forms, upload bank info, upload relocation receipts, complete benefits enrollment. Owner: marta.hr. Due: 2 business days.

sara.l: one last thing — HSA eligibility? i'm planning to enroll in the high-deductible plan but have a short gap between start and effective date — does that affect HSA contributions?

ben.vendor: HSA eligibility is tied to active coverage dates. if your HDHP effective date starts 1st of next month, HSA contributions can begin then. you cannot contribute pre-effective date. payroll can process a lump-sum contribution if needed once coverage is active, but tax implications vary. i can send the HSA FAQ.

marta.hr: i'll coordinate with ben.vendor to try and minimize the gap. sara, please upload your enrollment screenshots and appointment dates to the secure folder so we can prioritize. welcome aboard again! :tada:
